summary: Suppress near-duplicate alerts on POST /api/alerts within a configurable time window, returning the existing active alert with a suppression header instead of creating a new row.

acceptance_criteria.text: On POST /api/alerts, if an active alert with the same Title (case-insensitive) and same Severity was created within the last configurable window (default 15 minutes), do not create a new row.
When suppressed, respond 200 OK with the existing matching alert in the body and response header 'X-Duplicate-Suppressed: true'.
A genuinely new (non-duplicate) alert still creates a row and returns 201 Created (without the suppression header).
The suppression window in minutes is read from appsettings.json configuration and is not hardcoded.
Do not suppress when the candidate matches a prior alert of a different Severity.
Do not suppress when the only matching prior alert (same Title + Severity, within window) is inactive (IsActive = false).

constraints: Suppression window (minutes) must come from appsettings.json via bound options, never a hardcoded literal in service/repository code.
Title match is case-insensitive; Severity match is exact; only active (IsActive = true) prior alerts qualify.
Use the existing injected TimeProvider for 'now' when computing the window threshold; do not use DateTime.UtcNow directly.
Keep controller HTTP-only (status code + header) and keep business decision in the service layer, matching existing layering.
Do not change DTO request contract; CreateAlertRequest already carries Title, Severity, IsActive.
Preserve existing 201 Created + CreatedAtRoute behavior for non-duplicate alerts.
coverage_goals: Behavior coverage for suppression decision: duplicate within window suppressed; new alert created; different severity not suppressed; inactive prior not suppressed; boundary just outside window not suppressed.
unresolved_questions: RESOLVED in /implement-story: suppression window is bound from appsettings.json section 'AlertSuppression' key 'WindowMinutes' (default 15 when unset, via AlertSuppressionOptions.WindowMinutes). Suppression signalled to the controller via (AlertCreationStatus, AlertResponse) tuple; header name 'X-Duplicate-Suppressed' lives in AlertConstants.DuplicateSuppressedHeader.
